items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Cab -- he did the same thing.

ctx.x: I've never heard of any other band having one but I --
Yeah. Oh, Cab -- he did the same thing. And there were a few, but just a handful.

Again, in Barry Ulanov's book, he mentioned that John Hammond wrote about you saying after he first heard you with Duke, "He's a virtuoso of the first rank, one who is very conscious of his technical ability. Probably no other trombonist has his equipment, but I'm afraid that this brilliant musician is out of place in Duke's band." And then there's some quotes from Spike Hughes (of The Melody Maker) who felt that you were too sophisticated for jazz and Duke Ellington. Do you remember that?
